details.behindTheProduct:
At its heart lies the innovative ReactCore™ — PureFoam™ floating center with a new PureFoam™ Ring surrounded by an EVA Power Ring for a dynamic core with adaptive flexibility. This double-ring technology takes the EVA Power Ring players loved in Project Boomstik and refines it with an additional PureFoam Ring for a more connected feel with additional control. This gives you consistent playability across your paddle face with versatile all-court performance for the modern fast-paced game. You'll have great power, a plush feeling on control shots, and dwell to grab the ball for more spin.


This game-changing technology tailors its response to every swing, making this an all-court paddle built for the modern fast-paced game. Your paddle will feel less stiff than traditional solid cores while adapting to your game. Plus, its durability smashes through the standard set by a comparable polypropylene paddle.

With extensive testing on our durability cannon — which fires pickleballs at 110mph to simulate wear so  the change in core can be measured — the OMNI held strong while other paddles deteriorated. No core crush, just consistent performance that lasts.

This paddle also features the new Adjustable MOI Tuning System — a paddle technology that delivers elite performance with a maximum sweet spot and balance, right out of the box. First introduced on Project Boomstik®, this next generation of the MOI Tuning System gives you the option to remove and reapply the perimeter weights for your own preferences. 

Your paddle will come with pre-installed MOI weights that are precisely optimized for a maximum sweet spot and stabilized balance — helping you get more balls over the net. This works for the vast majority of players, and it's recommended to leave the weights for optimal performance. The MOI weights are designed to hold steady and will not shift during play. The combination of the innovative ReactCore™ and Adjustable MOI Tuning System gives you the ability to fine-tune this paddle to play however you want it to.

[See this step-by-step guide to customizing your MOI weights. Looking to reapply the weights as they came, for an optimized sweet spot? Use the reference marks on your paddle face as a guide.]

The OMNI offers versatility never seen in any other foam paddle. It’s power. It’s control. It’s redefined all-court performance that gives you the tools to win.

Available in two paddle shapes.

Widebody | Longer Handle & Wide Paddle Shape: The widebody shape features a longer handle for added reach and extra space for two-handed backhands. This shape enhances stability and delivers a more consistent, forgiving sweet spot — especially on off-center hits. Ideal for players seeking the largest sweet spot and a consistent feel and performance across the face.

Elongated | Longer Handle & Longest Paddle Shape: Give yourself a better chance on balls you have to reach for. The longer handle has ample room for two-handed backhands, while the elongated shape delivers greater plow-through and power on every shot.
